production.note: US model years of the 3.2-litre manual NSX. First: Acura's chronology for 1997: "new 3.2-liter DOHC 24-valve V-6 engine produces 290 hp and 224 lbs-ft torque with 6-speed manual transmission". Last: 2005, "no changes; final model year for NSX". The 2002 facelift ("pop-up headlights replaced with fixed-position HID") is part of this record: the guide does not separate a facelift with unchanged engine and rating. Cars with the SportShift automatic kept the 3.0-litre engine ("The SportShift automatic transmission-equipped NSX continues to utilize the potent 3.0-liter V-6", acura-nsx-1997-kit) and are not described by this record.

body.note: 1997 press kit lists the fixed-roof 'Coupe' beside the 'NSX-T' removable-roof car. As in the NA1 record, the NSX-T (sold under its own name until 2001) is not part of this record. From 2002 Acura's chronology says "all NSX models feature removable roof panel, NSX-T name dropped" (acura-nsx-chronology); those 2002-2005 cars are sold simply as NSX, not as a Targa, so they are kept here under Coupe. Consumer Guide's 2005 review describes a "lift-off 'targa' roof panel" (cg-nsx-2005).

aspiration.note: Inferred: 'Programmed Fuel Injection (PGM-FI) with Variable Volume Induction System'; no turbocharger or supercharger is listed.

transmission.note: '6-speed manual'. The 3.2-litre engine came only with the manual; the 4-speed SportShift automatic used the 3.0-litre engine. Consumer Guide's 2005 review still lists the '6-speed manual transmission' with the 3.2 (cg-nsx-2005).

powerHp.note: Manual 3.2-litre, 1997 model. Quote: "290 hp @7100 rpm". Acura's chronology repeats 290 hp for 1997 and lists no later power change; Consumer Guide's 2005 review (Tom Appel) gives '290-hp' for the manual 3.2 (cg-nsx-2005), so the rating held to the end.

weightLb.note: Fixed-roof Coupe, 6-speed manual, 1997 model. Quote (Curb Weight table, Coupe column): "Manual | 3069 lbs (1392 kg)". Same table: NSX-T manual 3164 lbs (1435 kg); automatics (3.0-litre) 3113 lbs Coupe and 3208 lbs NSX-T. No Acura weight for the 2002-2005 removable-roof car was opened.

reviewNotes: Scope decision: this record covers the 3.2-litre manual NSX for 1997-2005 (engine change = separate record per the guide; the 2002 facelift alone is not). The requested framing was '2002-2005 facelift'. From 2002 every US NSX had the removable roof formerly sold as NSX-T, while 1997-2001 the NSX-T was a separately named car excluded here as in the NA1 record; a human should confirm that the 2002-2005 removable-roof cars belong under 'Coupe' in this record. Weight (3,069 lb) is the 1997 fixed-roof Coupe; no Acura figure for the 2002-2005 car was found.
